description: This file implements the WritableIdentityCredential class, which manages the creation, updating, and signing of identity credentials, including handling access control profiles, entries, and attestation certificates within the Android hardware identity framework.

classes.name: WritableIdentityCredential
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the lifecycle of writable identity credentials, including initialization, personalization, entry management, signing, and finalization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the credential, setting up hardware proxy and internal state.

methods.name: initializeForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares the credential for an update with encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: getAttestationCertificate
methods.description: Generates and retrieves the attestation certificate chain for the credential.

methods.name: setExpectedProofOfProvisioningSize
methods.description: Sets the expected size of the proof of provisioning data.

methods.name: startPersonalization
methods.description: Begins the personalization process, setting up access control profiles and entry counts.

methods.name: addAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile with associated reader certificate and security parameters.

methods.name: beginAddEntry
methods.description: Starts the process of adding a new entry with specified access control profiles and size.

methods.name: addEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a chunk of data to the current entry, handling CBOR parsing and encryption.

methods.name: finishAddingEntries
methods.description: Finalizes the entries, signs the data, and produces the credential data and proof signature.
